name: B10-0246/2025 – § 4/2
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: calls for further action in this sector to address the significant obstacles that persist, starting from setting ambitious targets in the upcoming single market strategy;
part_context: Underscores that, as demonstrated by the Letta and Draghi reports, there is still untapped potential in the services sector; calls for further action in this sector to address the significant obstacles that persist, starting from setting ambitious targets in the upcoming single market strategy; notes that services account for three quarters of EU GDP, represent two thirds of employment and create 9 out of 10 new jobs in the EU economy; notes also, however, that services are still the least developed segment of the EU single market;
